meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: Claude 会暂停相关群组任务,把旧版 NanoClaw/Claude 记忆整理进共享 memory 树与常驻指令;对链接型旧文件只隔离链接本身而不追内容,最后提供迁移报告供你确认。
howto.when: 升级后提示共享记忆不兼容,或群组还带 .seed.md、旧版 CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆等旧内容时触发;说“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等也会唤起。

say.text: 请执行 migrate memory:升级后 agent 把一切都忘了。
say.note: 会进入迁移流程,先暂停相关任务并请你确认。

say.text: 把旧版 CLAUDE.md 和 .seed.md 并入共享记忆树。
say.note: 常规文件会先暂存,再分类和更新索引。

say.text: 先列出受影响群组和链接状态,再迁移。
say.note: 会停在审批前,不会直接改文件。

howto.what_en: Claude migrates legacy NanoClaw/Claude memory into the shared tree and standing instructions: it pauses group tasks, quarantines symlinks without following them, organizes the old content, and gives a report for approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, when a group still has legacy .seed.md/CLAUDE.md/auto-memory, or on “migrate memory”/“legacy memory”.

say_en.text: Please run migrate memory; the agent forgot everything after the switch.
say_en.note: Starts migration, pauses tasks, and asks approval.

say_en.text: Merge the old CLAUDE.md and .seed.md into the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: Files are staged, classified, and indexed.

say_en.text: List affected groups and link status before migrating.
say_en.note: It pauses until you approve the moves.
